newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB says leads Peabody debt programme.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB says leads Peabody debt programme.

text.p: National Australia Bank formally announced the launch of an A$400 million commercial paper and medium-term note programme for Peabody Finance Ltd as arranger and manager.
Earlier on Thursday, U.S. rating agency Standard & Poor's rated the programme A-1.
Peabody Finance Ltd is a wholly-owned subsidiary of The Energy Group Plc, which is a diversified global energy business with substantial interest in coal, power generation and distribution.
The Group was established after the demerger of the Hanson Group and has total assets of 5.7 billion stg (A$11.7 billion).
NAB is also issuing and paying agent, while ANZ Banking Group and Bankers Trust Australia Ltd are dealers on the programme.
Ian Mattiske, NAB's General Manager, Global Project and Structured Finance, said the new programme replaced an existing commercial paper programme.
"The medium term note component of the new programme also provides Peabody with the flexiblilty to capitalise on growing demand for corporate securities," Mattiske added.
